---
title: Life expectancy gains by region
description: Changes in Gapminder regional estimates from 1950 to 2019.
version: 0.1.0
styles: [scientific]
---

## Asia gained the most years

Asia's estimate increased by 29.3 years between 1950 and 2019. Africa gained 22.4 years, the Americas 16.7 and Europe 14.2. The Europe–Africa gap narrowed from 21.8 years to 13.6 years. The gain is the 2019 estimate minus the 1950 estimate.

```chart
type: bar
title: Life expectancy gains from 1950 to 2019
data: {csv: data.csv}
encoding: {x: region, y: gain}
axes:
  x: {label: Region}
  y: {label: Gain, unit: ' years'}
```

*Source: Gapminder, life expectancy at birth, version 15 (5 April 2026), regional averages weighted by population; [gapminder.org](https://www.gapminder.org/data/), CC BY 4.0. Gain is calculated by subtraction.*

Life expectancy and differences are in years.
